summary: This 8-K Item 8.01 filing reports Urban Outfitters, Inc.'s earnings release for the quarter ended April 30, 2026, disclosing record net sales of $1.48 billion (up 11.4%) and net income of $115.7 million ($1.30 EPS). No strategic event or transaction is announced; it is a routine earnings disclosure without any special-situation elements such as M&A, activism, or restructuring. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger corporate action.
